item: The Windows observation legs keep their junit report, under a 120-minute cap until a Windows cost table exists
summary: The nightly Windows legs plan from the Linux cost table (about 45 min predicted a leg); shard 1 measured 70.6 to over 90 min (runs 44734791675, 44849278064). Each leg now writes junit.xml in the workspace and uploads it as junit-windows-shard-N (14 days, on red too, never red itself); the cap is 120 min; CI_SHARDS.md gives the procedure for the Windows table from the six reports of one run whose legs all finished. Pinned with mutants in test_ci_shards.py.
